method: Separate greedy reference and independent date-key/receipt calculations, actual TokenCounter, deterministic random seed 0xC0DE7107; no DB/provider/label/candidate audit imports.
checks: exact candidate section and greedy decisions match independent reference
complete admitted chunks and offsets/hashes match receipts
token and character budgets never exceeded
limitations: The test checks mechanical packing of input chunks, not original-source identity, semantic completeness, answer behavior, or all-500 trace outcomes.
Randomized corpus is synthetic; it does not certify retrieved production chunks or the running audit.
